channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel H2
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel H2 (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel H2: Pier 70 Parcel H2 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 70 Parcel H2 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4117003.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel H2: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel H2: Parcel H2 is now described as a flexible commercial-office/residential parcel (D4D Figure 2.1.1 stripes it both; the baseline scenario is residential) instead of commercial-office, and the map use is mixed; six stories is the commercial limit and nine the residential limit. The uncited Brookfield brochure claims (pure office, ~430,000 RSF for H1-H2) were removed; the 2042 completion date is the original 2017 outside date, now tolled by the down market delay (extended to December 26, 2026, Port Item 11A), with no parcel-specific date sourced; the claim that the block has no Assessor lot was replaced with what the sources show; the tree grove is described as running parallel to the Bay Trail; the Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022; the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing; and the Board of Supervisors vote on the Development Agreement shows first reading Oct 31 and final passage Nov 14, 2017.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel H2: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
